scope: Incremental overlay for existing UNNS_ENTANGLE_I project
objective: Determine whether independently frozen UNNS-style generative assumptions can produce Bell-violating correlations without importing the Born rule or singlet-state probabilities.

frozen_assumptions.measurement_settings: freely chosen analyzer settings represented as planar angles

success_criteria.derived_distribution: A well-defined P(A,B|a,b) derived from the frozen generator assumptions
success_criteria.bell_violation: CHSH > 2 from derived rules without importing quantum probabilities
success_criteria.no_signalling: Local marginals independent of remote settings
success_criteria.assumption_audit: Any relaxed Bell assumption explicitly identified

failure_criteria.local_factorized_no_go: If the derived model remains Bell-local under measurement independence, CHSH cannot exceed 2
failure_criteria.conditional_reconstruction: If Bell violation requires inserting a quantum probability rule, count as conditional reconstruction rather than derivation
failure_criteria.underdetermined: If multiple admissible generators produce inequivalent P(A,B|a,b), no unique entanglement prediction is achieved

stopping_rule: One frozen construction, one adversarial verification round, then verdict.
